services.name: Helicopter Tour
services.desc: Along Nova Scotia’s Bay of Fundy coastline: gain spectacular views of: Nova Scotia’s vibrant wine region in the beautiful Annapolis Valley including: Blomidon, Cape Split, Minas Basin, and landscape within Nova Scotia’s Cliffs of Fundy UNESCO Geopark including Cape Sharp and Five Islands Provincial Park. Enjoy a tasting of NS wines at Benjamin Bridge, open year round. In the wintertime, bring your skates and have fun on the vineyard’s seasonal ice surface prior to your tasting. Relax overlooking the vineyard, by the fire in all seasons. Halifax Stanfield International Airport PHYSICAL ADDRESS 549 Barnes Drive Enfield, Nova Scotia B2T 1K3
